data.narrative:
Neura Robotics, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by David Reger, has raised $123.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, all operating in the robotics and manufacturing sector at Series B through Series D stages. Key private peers include Hadrian, Nimble Robotics, Exotec, and Dexterity.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using total raised as a proxy base of $1.4B and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $2.4B. The peer-median method anchors to a median valuation of $1.6B across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Exotec at $2.0B, Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B, Dexterity and Hadrian each at $1.6B, and Nimble Robotics at $1.0B), with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $2.0B. The stage-progression and peer-median methods diverge materially ($2.4B versus $1.6B), reflecting uncertainty in both the appropriate fundraising-to-valuation multiple and peer comparability. Key sensitivities include relative product maturity, revenue scale (not provided), and customer concentration relative to the peer set.
